title: Benchmark evidence receipt
description: Schema for the benchmark-evidence receipt a lane writes beside its results: what code, model, data and hardware produced a number, and whether the arm is valid. Reproducibility only. Rental administration -- who approved the spend, what it cost, which instance was destroyed and how that was proven -- is operational and lives in the private control plane, not here.

experiment_id.description: Unique identifier for this experiment (equivalent to run_id in local contexts)

work_id.description: Parent work item or task identifier (e.g., GitHub issue number)

hypothesis.description: Testable claim or research question this run addresses

expected_result.description: What the requester expects to observe if the hypothesis is correct

success_criteria.description: Concrete criteria that define a successful outcome

failure_criteria.description: Concrete criteria that define a failed outcome

preregistration.description: URL or path to the pre-registration document

commit_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the primary repository at run time

dirty_tree.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes at run time

dependencies.description: Map of dependency name to version string for key dependencies

command.description: The exact command executed in this run

environment.description: Key environment variables set for this run

started_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the run started

finished_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp (UTC) when the run ended

dataset.description: Dataset name or identifier used in this run

dataset_hash.description: Hash of the dataset, or null if not applicable

model_revision.description: Model revision or version (e.g., git commit, HF revision)

model_hash.description: Hash of the model weights, or null if not computed

seed.description: Random seed used for reproducibility, or null if not set

metrics.description: Measured metrics and results from the run

artifacts.description: List of output artifacts produced by this run

path.description: Relative path to the artifact within the run directory

bytes.description: Size of the artifact in bytes

status.description: Execution status from the harness vocabulary

notes.description: Free-text notes about the run (observations, issues, context)
